entities.label: Lord Sorven
entities.reason: The polished transcript calls him Sorven; the vault filename and some references use Soven. Role and court identify the same person; retain the source spelling without renaming anything.

entities.label: Lady Eventide
entities.reason: Her spirit occupies Seeker and speaks through that PC’s body; she remains a separate NPC identity.

entities.label: Cloudspinner
entities.reason: An imprisoned archfey, not divine merely for her power. The DM corrects the earlier Apollyon attribution to Cha’mutte; no release occurs in this session.

entities.label: Apollyon
entities.reason: A defeated lich in the party’s retrospective stories. The later correction distinguishes his aims from Cha’mutte’s role in imprisoning Cloudspinner.

entities.label: Harrow
entities.reason: Named hostile archfey, discussed through servants and threats. Keep Harrow and Wend separately addressable; their deeper relationship is not settled by the notes.

entities.label: Wend
entities.reason: Named hostile archfey; references to servants do not constitute a direct encounter with Wend.

entities.label: Lirien
entities.reason: Her past guidance, Amberlight, mount, and death are recalled; she is not alive at the revel.

entities.label: Gloomshaper
entities.reason: The named ruler of Duskmire matches the public Gloomshaper alias. His threatened intervention is discussed, not played.

entities.label: Yasara the Golden
entities.reason: A named person in Valeris’s curse story, not a current guest. No individual note in person filenames, names, aliases, or Yasara references; Valeris’s note preserves the same story.

entities.label: Ismara of Gleamwater
entities.reason: The DM immediately corrects Ashara to Ismara. Her book and questioning initially raise suspicion; the later checks support her stated scholarly purpose, without proving every possible motive.

entities.label: Woman who fled the Sunset Gate
entities.reason: A particular past dueling opponent whose story Arendel recalls. No supported individual match from names, aliases, or duel/Sunset Gate references; do not invent her name or attendance.

entities.label: Caulaus
entities.reason: A former guest PC substantively discussed as a separate person with missing memories; no present attendance is inferred.

entities.label: Agata
entities.reason: The party discusses her earlier imprisonment and uncertain continuing danger. Do not turn speculation about killing her again into an escape or new encounter.

entities.label: Guardian of Heartwood Grove
entities.reason: The retrospective guardian account identifies the murdered Heartwood Grove guardian as Typhina. Keep the unnamed session label and distinguish the real guardian from Agata’s impersonation; this is a reported past death.

entities.label: Cha’mutte
entities.reason: The elder dragon in Vashan’s recovered memories, distinguished from Apollyon by the explicit correction. Killing gods was his ambition, not proof that he was divine.

entities.label: Cha’mutte’s daughter guarding Cloudspinner
entities.reason: The particular daughter guarding the island prison matches Ra’ghemdros’s public history. Retain the source role; this is a retrospective reminder, not a live encounter.

entities.label: Lirien’s flying golden stag
entities.reason: A particular companion mount recalled as a transport example. No individual page found in person filenames, aliases, or Lirien/stag references.

entities.label: Wyvern released from the mirror
entities.reason: A particular former captive becomes a prospective companion and mount. No named individual page in filenames, aliases, or mirror references. Willingness to carry riders is not reliable combat obedience.

entities.label: Kinzal mage and messenger
entities.reason: A particular earlier prisoner recalled in the mirror inventory. No individual page in person filenames, aliases, or mage/messenger references. Current custody is asserted here; later uncertainty is not resolved retroactively.

entities.label: Hobgoblin wizard in the mirror
entities.reason: Retrospective mirror accounts identify the long-held hobgoblin spellcaster as Revaka. Keep the session’s role label and distinguish her from the Kinzal messenger; no new interrogation occurs here.

entities.label: Poison troll at Shadowkeep
entities.reason: A specific former mirror captive now said to rule the ruins, not a generic monster. No individual page in person filenames, aliases, or poison-troll references.

entities.label: Vampire at the earlier Urskan negotiation
entities.reason: Retrospective Shadowkeep accounts identify the vampire in the earlier Urskan negotiation as Rhodar von Glauer. Keep the session’s unnamed role; no surviving vampire or new meeting is inferred.

entities.label: Grash
entities.reason: Named in the discussion of Wellby’s earlier death and return; not currently present.

entities.label: Golden-suited feast attendant
entities.reason: A distinctive individual who welcomes and serves the party. No individual match from person names, aliases, Sunwine court references, or appearance; do not silently identify him with Lord Sorven.

entities.label: The Cleansed in the mirror
entities.reason: The source uses the faction name while discussing Riswynn-controlled captives. Review this grouping: affiliation or magical coercion does not establish that every prisoner was a willing cult member.

entities.label: Court of the Master of the Revels
entities.reason: The ruler’s court functions as a named political and social institution. The shared hall page explicitly describes the court, but review the boundary between institution and location.

entities.label: Auntie Mulberry’s small flute
entities.reason: A particular gifted guide whose tune leads the party to Sunwine Hall. No individual page from item filenames, aliases, or flute/Mulberry references; the gift is recalled rather than newly received here.

entities.label: Cloudspinner’s crystal prison
entities.reason: A particular remaining layer of imprisonment shown to Vashan. No individual object page in item filenames, aliases, or prison references; do not mistake showing it for freeing its captive.

entities.label: Lirien’s Amberlight
entities.reason: This type page explicitly records Lirien’s particular lantern. Track that instance without merging all captured Amberlights into one physical object.

entities.label: Riswynn’s fragment of the beginning
entities.reason: The dangerous, not-yet-mastered artifact carried by Riswynn matches the crown’s public ownership and origin. The source describes its nature but never names it here; review the contextual match.

entities.label: Ismara’s illustrated book
entities.reason: A particular magical book used to summon historical images and record speech by tracing fingers. No dedicated item page in filenames, aliases, or Ismara/book references; distinct from Ulfgar’s published book.

entities.label: The Lore of the Feywild
entities.reason: A named book used as authority for Gleamwater’s identity. Review whether this brief reference is significant enough for the item inventory; no newly acquired physical copy is established.

entities.label: Mirror of Soul Trapping
entities.note: Campaigns/Dunmari Frontier Campaign/Treasure/Mirror of Soul Trapping.md
entities.reason: The party revisits its prisoners, releases a wyvern, and discusses recapture limits. This is substantive inventory and capability discussion rather than a routine activation alone.

entities.label: Prismwell vial in the keep to be sought
entities.reason: The party seeks a particular surviving vial through the keeps’ history and sunlight requirement. No dedicated item page from names, aliases, or vial references; existence and location of this prospective instance remain unconfirmed.

entities.label: The party’s flying castle
entities.reason: The specific ship is recalled in stories and explains how the party crossed the wasteland; no current flight in this Feywild session is inferred.

entities.label: Delwath’s elven blade
entities.reason: Arendel recognizes the blade’s elven origin and age, and Delwath introduces its acquisition story. This brief lore warrants inclusion; the full origin story is not recorded. Narëngril matches the public ownership account.

exclusions.label: Current PCs, including Seeker
exclusions.reason: The YAML PC identities remain distinct from Lady Eventide, who occupies Seeker. Seeker’s lack of an active speaking identifier does not make him a new NPC.

exclusions.label: Putrid Agnes and Hansel and Gretel analogy
exclusions.reason: The DM uses these as comparisons for a trap that this party is not; no substantive discussion of those individuals occurs.

exclusions.label: Arendel’s sword and Delwath’s shield
exclusions.reason: Appearance and normal duel uses do not establish meaningful object lore or new objects.

exclusions.label: Yezali’s Frost and unnamed gods in duel banter
exclusions.reason: A named combat feature and general blessing/toast do not identify a separate substantive divine referent here.

exclusions.label: Ordinary Feywine and feast provisions
exclusions.reason: Consumables and a regional substance, not individually distinguished artifacts. The wine’s memory effects remain important evidence for Vashan and the wyvern.

exclusions.label: Five colorful griffins
exclusions.reason: Loaned mounts are described collectively, without names or individually distinguishing traits. Review whether to include a collective companion record or five separate unnamed NPCs.

exclusions.label: Duskhounds, shadow minions, musicians, and party crowds
exclusions.reason: Creature types and unspecified followers or crowds do not establish individual NPCs or a separately named organization.

exclusions.label: Chanceweaver in Chanceweaver’s Court
exclusions.reason: The name occurs only as a location on Ismara’s travel route, without substantive reference to its ruler.

exclusions.label: Prismwell, keeps, archives, and Cloud Palace
exclusions.reason: Places and architectural locations rather than separate entity kinds in this map. Planned visits and historical images do not establish attendance.

exclusions.label: Unnamed dragons and early duel opponents
exclusions.reason: Passing generic recollections without enough individual identity to resolve; the specifically identified prison-guard daughter is tracked separately.
